summary_rationale: ABM Industries is a durable $8.75B+ revenue ($9.15B TTM) essential facility-services leader with a 58-year dividend-increase streak and promising high-tech growth verticals in Aviation, M&D semiconductor cleanrooms (WGNSTAR), and Technical Solutions microgrids/UPS (RavenVolt, Quality Uptime). However, consolidated ROIC (~4.62%) sits below WACC due to $2.59B in M&A goodwill (145% of equity), GAAP net margin is thin (~1.86%), ELEVATE ERP/CapEx investments have constrained FCF conversion ($155.1M in FY2025), and B&I (47.2% of sales) faces ongoing commercial office vacancy headwinds. Business quality is therefore conditional on deleveraging from ~2.9x toward 2.5x and scaling higher-margin technical mix.
